## Definition

Assume the Axiom of Choice and fix constants $0<\kappa_-<\kappa_+<\infty$ and $0<	heta_{\max}<\pi/2$. Let $M=\mathbb R^3\setminus\{0\}$, $r=|\mathbf k|$, $\mathbf n=\mathbf k/r$, and use the positive $z$ axis as the propagation axis. Set $	heta(\mathbf k)=\arccos(n_z)\in[0,\pi]$ and let $\varphi\in\mathbb R/(2\pi\mathbb Z)$ be the azimuth on $0<	heta<\pi$. Use the transverse Hilbert space $\mathcal H_T^

u=d^3\mathbf k/(2|\mathbf k|)$ and the helicity projectors $P_\sigma(\mathbf n)=(P(\mathbf n)+\sigma h(\mathbf n))/2$, where $P=I-\mathbf n\mathbf n^T$, $h=i(\mathbf n	imes\cdot)$, and $\sigma\in\{+1,-1\}$. A normalized helicity-$\sigma$ packet in the paraxial cone is a vector $f\in\mathcal H_T^
u$ such that $\|f\|_
u=1$, $P_\sigma(\mathbf n(\mathbf k))f(\mathbf k)=f(\mathbf k)$ almost everywhere, and $f(\mathbf k)=0$ almost everywhere unless $\kappa_-\le |\mathbf k|\le\kappa_+$ and $0\le	heta(\mathbf k)\le	heta_{\max}$.

On the north patch $U_N=S^2\setminus\{-e_z\}$, write $\mathbf e_	heta=(\cos	heta\cos\varphi,\cos	heta\sin\varphi,-\sin	heta)$ and $\mathbf e_\varphi=(-\sin\varphi,\cos\varphi,0)$. Define $e_\sigma=(\mathbf e_	heta+i\sigma\mathbf e_\varphi)/\sqrt2$ and $e_\sigma^N=e^{i\sigma\varphi}e_\sigma$, with its smooth extension at $+e_z$. The south gauge is $e_\sigma^S=e^{-i\sigma\varphi}e_\sigma$; the transition is $e_\sigma^N=e^{2i\sigma\varphi}e_\sigma^S$, and neither helicity line has a global smooth unit frame. For an integer $\ell$, a north-gauge vortex coefficient has azimuthal factor $e^{i\ell\varphi}$. For the class defined here, a coefficient whose support reaches the axis is required to have the sufficient regular form $b(r,\cos	heta)(\sin	heta)^{|\ell|}e^{i\ell\varphi}$ with $b$ smooth; a smooth envelope supported away from the axis also makes $e^{i\ell\varphi}$ regular for every integer $\ell$. The winding $\ell$ is a label in this chosen patch, not a global orbital label. Use the rotation convention $U(R_z(t))f(\mathbf k)=R_z(t)f(R_z(-t)\mathbf k)=e^{-itJ_z/\hbar}f(\mathbf k)$.
lem-qftx-paraxial-vortex-packet-existenc:
## Statement

Assume the Axiom of Choice and Countable Choice, and fix $0<\kappa_-<\kappa_+<\infty$ and $0<\theta_1<\theta_2<\theta_{\max}<\pi/2$. For each $\sigma\in\{+1,-1\}$ and $\ell\in\mathbb Z$, there exist nonzero real functions $a\in C_c^\infty((\kappa_-,\kappa_+))$ and $b\in C_c^\infty((\theta_1,\theta_2))$ that equal $1$ on nonempty subintervals. For any such functions, put $r=|\mathbf k|$ and let $\theta,\varphi$ be the spherical angles. On the support of $a(r)b(\theta)$ define $f^0_{\sigma,\ell}(\mathbf k)=a(r)b(\theta)e^{i\ell\varphi}e_\sigma^N(\mathbf k/r)$ and extend by zero. Set $A=\int_{\kappa_-}^{\kappa_+}r|a(r)|^2\,dr$, $B=\int_{\theta_1}^{\theta_2}\sin\theta\,|b(\theta)|^2\,d\theta$, and $f_{\sigma,\ell}=f^0_{\sigma,\ell}/\sqrt{\pi AB}$. Then $f_{\sigma,\ell}\in\mathcal D$, $\|f_{\sigma,\ell}\|_\nu=1$, $P_\sigma f_{\sigma,\ell}=f_{\sigma,\ell}$, and $J_zf_{\sigma,\ell}=(\ell+\sigma)\hbar f_{\sigma,\ell}$. The packet has compact positive radial support and nonzero angular width; its support avoids the axis, so $e^{i\ell\varphi}$ is smooth for every integer $\ell$.
prop-qftx-paraxial-spin-error:
## Statement

Assume the Axiom of Choice and Countable Choice, $\hbar>0$, and fix $0<\kappa_-<\kappa_+<\infty$ and $0<\theta_{\max}<\pi/2$. Let $f$ be a normalized helicity-$\sigma$ packet in the cone $\kappa_-\le |\mathbf k|\le\kappa_+$, $0\le\theta(\mathbf k)\le\theta_{\max}$, with $\sigma\in\{+1,-1\}$. For the helicity-projected operator $S'_z$ on the transverse one-photon Hilbert space,
$$\langle f,S'_zf\rangle_\nu=\hbar\sigma\int_M\cos\theta(\mathbf k)|f(\mathbf k)|^2\,d\nu(\mathbf k),\qquad |\langle f,S'_zf\rangle_\nu-\hbar\sigma|\le\hbar(1-\cos\theta_{\max})\le\frac{\hbar\theta_{\max}^2}{2}.$$
For the exact north-gauge vortex packet of winding $\ell$ constructed in the preceding lemma, $J_z$ has eigenvalue $(\ell+\sigma)\hbar$, and $L'_z=J_z-S'_z$ therefore satisfies
$$\langle f,L'_zf\rangle_\nu=\ell\hbar+\hbar\sigma\left(1-\int_M\cos\theta(\mathbf k)|f(\mathbf k)|^2\,d\nu(\mathbf k)\right),\qquad |\langle f,L'_zf\rangle_\nu-\ell\hbar|\le\frac{\hbar\theta_{\max}^2}{2}.$$
The integer $\ell$ is the coefficient winding in the chosen north gauge; neither formula asserts a global gauge-independent orbital label.
